# Director, Media - Commercial Music Group

Company: Sony Music Entertainment
Location: United States, California, Los Angeles
Salary range: $115,000-$135,000 USD
Source URL: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/sonymusicentertainment/jobs/8633207002

## Job Description

About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Based in our Los Angeles office and as part of the central media team within the Commercial Music Group, and reporting to the SVP of Media, lead paid advertising strategy, planning, optimization, and performance analysis for specific labels and projects across social, digital, out-of-home, and other traditional channels.

What you'll do:
Execution and campaign setup across social, CTV, programmatic, and other ad platforms
Negotiate, plan, and implement traditional media programs through strategic collaborations with traditional channel partners (out-of-home, print, trade, radio, TV)
Collaborate with both the central media team and other departments (e.g., marketing, content, audience development, and analytics) to create cohesive strategies guided by key business outcomes
Utilize various internal and external tools to develop data-informed insights that provide the framework and approach for media strategies
Help create focused, creative, and breakthrough media plans that provide immediate impact as well as key learnings for the future
Develop and conduct key ad operation tasks engineered for media and business goal performance
Focus on optimizations during campaign flights to consistently improve performance and generate key learnings
Deliver performance results, as well as key creative and media insights, during and upon completion of campaigns
Provide a regular cadence of performance insights (by artist, genre, and playlist group), budget recaps, and analyses
Help evaluate creative and provide suggestions and recommendations on assets to set campaigns up for success and test new approaches
Aid in the financial reconciliation process (PO requests, PO creation, invoice approvals/distribution, troubleshooting)
Develop media strategies around music award nominations and voting windows, such as the Grammys, CMAs, and ACMs
Test new ad products and provide insight on efficacy for business use cases
Provide input on ad processes, tools, and structures to create the most efficient, automated, and effective ways of working
Keep all project trackers, request forms, plans, and reports up to date and accurate

Who you are:
6–8 years of advertising and/or marketing experience with an agency or brand (music industry experience is a plus)
Self-starter with a strong tolerance for high-volume, quick-turnaround work
Working knowledge of key ad platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Snap, Google Ads, Amazon, demand-side platforms (DSPs), and others
Traditional media planning and strong negotiation skills across channels
Familiarity and applied knowledge of tracking, measurement, and tagging technologies and methodologies (e.g., pixels, events, integrations, and GTM)
Use of reporting, dashboard, and analytics tools (e.g., Adverity, Supermetrics, Looker Studio, and similar tools)
Proficiency with MS Office, Canva, Google tools, and other spreadsheet and presentation tools
Strong oral and written communication skills
Love and passion for music
Curious and forward-thinking about the state and future of media and its integration with music

What we give you:
An inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey
Training on internal and proprietary marketing and data tools
Opportunity for growth, development, and mentorship
Ability to work in a modern office designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
An excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks
The platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.
